description: Department of Labour - Special Allowance Payable to workers in the Cocoa, Cardamom and Pepper growing and Manufacturing Trade
reasoning: This gazette notification announces a special allowance for workers in the cocoa, cardamom, and pepper trade under the authority of the Wages Boards Ordinance. It is a regulatory matter concerning wage adjustments based on the Cost of Living Index, falling under Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) for statutory instruments and regulatory frameworks.
